pla-01.prompt: Flat two-dimensional educational illustration. Simple closed shapes, clear dark outlines, completely solid uniform fills. No gradients, shading or texture. Two separate groups of equally sized BLUE circles, MANY circles on the left, about twelve, and only two circles on the right. A single bold red downward pointer arrow above identifies the MANY circles in the LEFT group. Entire uniform solid shapes, a wide clear gap between groups, no people, written labels, digits or mathematical signs. Single square CACE vocabulary image. Pure white background. Show every subject and essential prop whole inside the middle two thirds of the canvas. Zoom OUT, leave one sixth of canvas width empty at both sides, generous white above and below. Natural anatomically correct hands. Plain shoes and clothing. No border. Absolutely no text, writing, letters, numbers, labels, brand marks, emblems, logos or watermarks anywhere.
